response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack and web software engineer with no evidence of embedded systems, Linux kernel work, network security protocols, or Japanese language proficiency, all of which are mandatory requirements for this role. His skill set (JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, web frameworks) does not align with the required C/UNIX embedded development or LAN-switch security domain.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software development experience across multiple stacks
Strong track record of technical leadership and staff-level roles
Demonstrated ability to learn new domains (e.g., low-latency systems, robotics)
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency, which is a mandatory requirement
No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel investigation or modification
No background in network security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption) or embedded/LAN-switch products

key_factors.factor: No embedded/Linux kernel or security domain experience
